text: [175] 85 tatra kho āyasmā sārīputto bhikkhū āmantesi .pe. chahāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ . katamehi chahi . idhāvuso bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu sutānañca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti dhatānañca dhammānaṃ atthūpaparikkhī 1 hoti atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno ca hoti kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ . imehi kho āvuso chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ .
